The challenge

Make the firm's existing website content easy for AI search tools and crawlers to find, read and understand.

What I did

Worked on llms.txt updates and AI-readable content organization, with a focus on technical SEO and AI crawler optimization. The work centered on making existing website information more clearly structured for automated discovery.

The stack

  • llms.txt
  • Technical SEO
  • Content structure
  • AI crawlers

The result

An llms.txt file and a clearer content structure that point AI tools straight to the key pages and services.
